Prompts: REA_17 §3.4. · edge (catalyst pole only; owner 2026-10-16, THE EDGE v9: two sentences, the energy and its three ruling domains from the GOD table, then a clause per domain in The Pattern's voice; the metric; the head derived in the app)

candidates.structural_interaction: Wood generating Fire same-polarity — reach as natural source of warmth and expression
candidates.k2_overview: Your Fire moves as the Artisan: warmth that cooks instead of burns. You turn heat into hospitality, talent into entertainment, an ordinary evening into something people retell for years. Pleasure is your medium and generosity your technique. The feast only fails when the cook forgets to eat.
candidates.k2_functional: You express in performances of warmth: stories, meals, toasts that leave everyone lit.

k2_domain_readings.Expression: Your expression is the lit table: cooking, performing, hosting, celebrating. It is real art, so treat it as one. The gatherings you make are the memories a whole circle keeps.
k2_domain_readings.Enjoyment: You enjoy loudly and generously, and your appetite blesses whatever it touches. The discipline is savoring over consuming: fewer, better feasts. The flame tastes more when it eats slower.
k2_domain_readings.Children: With the young you are the warm hearth: fun, feeding, festival. They will remember your kitchen as childhood itself. Add one steady ritual to the sparkle, so the warmth has a schedule they can lean on.

catalyst.define: As a catalyst, the light burns low and reaches only the people nearest you. What little shows comes out as warmth.

angles.drive: Giving is the easiest thing you do. You would rather be useful than be thanked, and you give before being asked. The people near you feel looked after before they know they need it.
angles.cost_self: Something to give away is where you are most at ease. Giving comes before wanting, and you would sooner give one more thing than name what you need. Underneath, you want someone to offer before you have to ask.
angles.cost_others: Whenever the people around you need something, you have given it before they ask. Providing feels safer than receiving, so you hand out more than you let in. Those close to you seldom get the pleasure of returning the favour.

angles.drive: Enjoying something quietly was never your way. You feel a pleasure fully only once it is shared, and you would rather enjoy a small thing with company than a big thing alone. A dinner with you turns into an occasion.
angles.cost_self: Enjoyment only counts for you when it is shared. You write off an evening alone as wasted, and you pick less enjoyment in company over more by yourself. Hours on your own feel empty, and the good in them passes you by.
angles.cost_others: Whatever you enjoy, you pull the people near you into enjoying as well. You run the fun rather than have it, and you leave little for the quieter people to add. Their own ideas of a good time get lost inside yours.

angles.drive: What you make comes out without strain. Ease is the sign you trust, and you would rather do the thing that flows than force the thing that counts. Your work has a lightness people feel at once.
angles.cost_self: Effort was never your measure of worth. You rate what comes easily below what you fought for, so you hand the easy work over free instead of charging for it. Your income is smaller than your talent.
angles.cost_others: You make hard things look easy. You would rather show the finished thing than the work, and the people learning from you get the ease without the steps. Anyone watching you sees how good the result can be.

friction.define: As a friction, the warmth runs toward the comfort you need. Your hours go to the soft option and the next favour, and your own work stays undone.

angles.drive: Saying no has never come easily to you. A yes keeps the evening warm and everyone pleased, and you agree before you check what it costs. You never had to buy your place with a yes.
angles.cost_self: Staying on good terms with whoever asks is what your yes is for. Being needed feels safer than being rested, so you say yes to the evening rather than keep it. Each rest you turn down, you pay for later with your health.
angles.cost_others: You answer whoever asks first with a yes, and you leave the people at home what is left. Pleasing the person in front of you comes before keeping your word at home. You give your family the leftovers of a day promised to others.

angles.drive: You drift toward whatever asks the least of you. You treat ease as the reward you are owed, and you let a day drift rather than steer it. You land where the days carry you instead of where you meant to go.
angles.cost_self: Drifting costs you nothing on any single day. Taking it easy feels better than taking it on, so once again you put off the thing you meant to start. You lose the one thing you most wanted to make, a day at a time.
angles.cost_others: Whatever the people around you decide, you drift along with it. Going along feels better than having a view, and you hand the deciding to whoever is nearest. Day after day, you leave them to make the choices for you both.

angles.drive: You put pleasure first and the rest after. Feeling good is how you check you are alive, so you take the nicer option over the needed one. You were after feeling alive all along, and pleasure was only the quickest way.
angles.cost_self: Pleasure first is the one care you trust. Feeling comforted matters more to you than feeling well, and you take comfort now over health later. You pay for it in the body, and the body keeps a longer memory than you do.
angles.cost_others: Whenever a plan with others meets your pleasure, you choose the pleasure. You would rather have a good time now than keep a promise later, and the evening wins. You leave them short on the plans you made together.

edge.lead: Fire runs through your health, your family and your career. It is the deep sleep that comes when nothing in you is forced, the small thing you hand over before anyone asks, and the work that comes out easy because you liked making it.
